jobs.occupation: Postdoc - Characterization of CHO Host Cell Proteins (Biochemiker/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Tasks & responsibilities

- You will characterize and investigate CHO host cell proteins, with a particular focus on critical and difficult-to-remove species that may affect downstream processing and product stability.
- Using advanced mass spectrometry-based approaches, you will identify, quantify, and profile host cell proteins and support impurity risk assessment through data-driven analyses.
- You will establish, optimize, and apply analytical and functional assays to evaluate host cell protein behavior at trace levels throughout different purification stages.
- Through recombinant protein expression strategies, you will enable the in-depth characterization of selected host cell proteins under controlled experimental conditions.
- In close collaboration with downstream process development and analytics, you will investigate interactions between host cell proteins and therapeutic proteins and translate findings into risk mitigation strategies.
- As principal investigator for research and technology projects, you will lead scientific studies, oversee project execution and data interpretation, supervise students and technical staff, and communicate results effectively to stakeholders and management.

Requirements

- PhD in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, Biology, or a related scientific discipline
- Strong expertise in protein biochemistry and molecular characterization, ideally including experience with host cell proteins (HCPs)
- Hands-on experience with mass spectrometry-based protein identification and quantification methods, preferably with a focus on host cell protein analysis
- Experience in MS data processing and analysis using bioinformatics tools, including both raw and processed datasets; knowledge of recombinant protein expression and purification is highly desirable
- Solid understanding of downstream processing concepts, chromatography principles, and data-driven experimental design and quantitative data analysis
- Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, supported by a strong scientific publication record and excellent English communication, scientific writing, and documentation skills

We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist to join our Mass Spectrometry based Biomarker team within the Drug Discovery Sciences (DDS) department in Germany. You'll work at the cutting edge of drug discovery - shaping breakthrough therapies and making an immediate impact.
In this role, you will represent your scientific discipline in cross-functional teams, advance cutting-edge methods in proteomics, mass spectrometry, and molecular sciences. jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Tasks & responsibilities

- Your primary responsibilities will include coordinating, evaluating, and conducting in silico assessments to predict mutagenicity in accordance with ICH M7, including the scientific evaluation of related literature searches.
- In close collaboration with i internal and external stakeholders, you will develop and support derisking strategies for mutagenic impurities and metabolites across different stages of project development.
- Furthermore, you will prepare scientific reports, including expert judgment on the relevance of findings, and contribute to regulatory submission documents.
- As a subject matter expert, you will advise Research & Development teams on mutagenic impurities, mutagenic metabolites, and acceptable exposure limits for mutagenic carcinogens.
- In addition, you will represent scientific results and recommendations in international project teams, discuss their implications, and support informed risk-based decision-making.
- You will also independently manage and respond to health authority inquiries related to ICH M7 topics, coordinate global project requirements, and ensure compliance with regulatory expectations and internal procedures.

Additional tasks for the Senior Principal Scientist-Role

- With regard to the global genotoxicity strategy, you will take a leading role in its implementation and further development to ensure the application of avoidance principles and scientifically sound risk assessments.
- Moreover, you will lead complex and time-critical issues with significant regulatory impact and provide recommendations to international stakeholders.
- Additionally, you will contribute to scientific committees and expert forums, foster scientific exchange, and drive the advancement of scientific standards and best practices.

Requirements

- PhD in Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry Eor comparable scientific degree with relevant professional experience, or Master's degree in Biology or Computer Science
- Solid knowledge of mutagenicity, structural reactivity, and genetic toxicology
- Expertise in in silico mutagenicity prediction, including relevant software tools, derisking strategies, and associated genetic toxicology assays
- Experience in literature research and the use of scientific databases
- Knowledge of pharmaceutical development and the application of genetic toxicology principles in a drug development environment
- Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, work effectively under pressure, and communicate complex scientific findings in German and English

Additional requirements for the Senior Principal Scientist-Role

- Extensive experience in applying and interpreting in silico mutagenicity assessments within pharmaceutical development
- Demonstrated capability to lead complex scientific topics and coordinate cross-functional global stakeholders
- Experience in representing scientific positions in interactions with health authorities, scientific committees, or expert forums

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to lead and coordinate all aspects of clinical monitoring and site management for complex clinical trials. - Provide expert input into monitoring strategies and clinical operations best practices

- - Drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to resolution and proactively mitigate risk

- Minimum 5+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate / Monitor
- Valid driver’s license
- Full right to work in Germany
- Fluency in German and English (C1 level) – interviews will be conducted in German

- Excellent understanding and application of ICH-GCP and applicable regulations

- High attention to detail and strong organizational skills

We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly’s operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

- Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
- Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
- Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
- Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
- Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
- Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
- Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
- Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

- Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
- Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
- Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
- Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
- Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
- Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
- Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

- DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
- Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
- GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
- Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
- Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.
- Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

- Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.
- Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.
- Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.
- Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.
- A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

About Smartly

Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.

We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.
